payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each start, compute max over j of (forward distance i->j + (cnt_j-1)*n + min forward distance from j to a destination), derived via exchange argument.
payload.rationale: The solution relies on a greedy exchange argument: for each station, optimal order delivers farthest candies first to make the final one-way trip as short as possible; overall time is max of station completion times plus initial travel.
